newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to hold import rice tender on Dec 25.
newsitem.headline: Japan to hold import rice tender on Dec 25.

text.p: The Japanese Food Agency will hold an import tender for 7,000 tonnes of rice on December 25, agency officials said on Friday.
The simultaneous buy-and-sell (SBS) tender will be the third such tender this year, after a 5,000-tonne tender in July and 10,000-tonne tender in November.
Under a General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade deal in 1993, Japan agreed to gradually open up its rice market, pledging to buy 455,000 tonnes of foreign rice in fiscal 1996/97 ending next March.
